evidence.requirements: Nearly every requirement is met. Start page: heading, links named exactly by record name, family, L3 with tolerance, Search/Family filters and an '<n> cartridges' count (views.js:25-66, list.jpg). Search normalises commas and spaces (search.js:9-11). Detail view: the facts, water capacity with source link, tables with Symbol/Value/Unit, Print and All cartridges, and hash routes (views.js:74-125, app.js). Drawing: inline SVG, aria-label '<name> drawing', section below the axis, dash-dot centre line, every required dimension, title block with name/table/revised/'Dimensions in mm'/scale (drawing.js:59-94, layout.js:174-229). Notes name missing values (44 Mag., 9,3 x 74 R screenshots). Print fits one A4 page (print-308_win.jpg). Partly met: 'scales to phone width' works, but at 360 px the 2.8 mm labels come out at about 7 px (test/out/phone-draw.png). The angle marker for α is tiny. The hatching on the 0.6 mm case walls hardly shows (detail-308_win.jpg).
evidence.correctness: The geometry follows the rules closely. Chamfer: geometry.js:203-205. Rimfire half-round: 185-193. Groove and belt ramp at δ: 223-242, with 300 WM ramp end 3.238 checked in a test. Fillets r1 min/r2: 272-286. Seating s and k per shape and category: 119-127. Tangent ogive with ρ and centre per the brief: 132-141. Heeled 22 LR with H2 and H2-2tb: 359-360. Walls tb/tn blended across the shoulder: 391-396. w terms: 327-331. Pocket sizes: 18-19. 308, 300 WM, 9 mm and 22 LR outlines match the reference proportions, and dimension values match the data. Angles show as 40° / 10°58'0" and tolerances sit beside the value (format.js:29-48). Weak points: the α arc sits at the body-side corner with a radius of about 3 mm, too small to read. The straight-case wall blend runs from w to the bullet base, a design choice. The Unit column repeats '°' after values that already carry °.
evidence.security: All text goes through createTextNode (dom.js:24). The SVG string escapes every data-derived text and attribute (drawing.js:18-20, 47, 78, 88) before insertAdjacentHTML (drawing.js:127). Source links are restricted to http(s) (views.js:88). There is no eval and no fetch, and the only external URLs are user-clicked links.
evidence.code_quality: Clear modules: pure format/search/tables/geometry/layout files, a DOM builder, views and a router. Names are good and missing values are handled defensively (pos/has, finite checks at drawing.js:96). Classic IIFE scripts are justified for file:// (README). The label placement uses a brute-force grid search over about 45k offsets per label (layout.js:69-80), heavier than needed but contained. Some functions are long (buildModel ~200 lines).
evidence.tests: Unit tests check exact rule geometry for each family: chamfer, groove, belt, half-round rim, fillets, ogive circle, ellipse, heel, walls, w and pockets (geometry.test.js). Layout tests check no label overlap for all 25 records, true-to-scale dimension lengths and arrows/extension lines (layout.test.js:31-102). E2E tests cover search by alternative name, family filter, reload/bookmark, tables, the tolerance format, print black-on-white in dark mode, label size ≥6 pt, and one A4 page for every cartridge via PDF page count (print.test.js:90-105).
evidence.ux_design: Dense, calm technical presentation. The facts block, then drawing, then 4-column grouped tables with monospace tabular numbers read well (detail-308_win.jpg). The print layout is excellent: facts in 3 columns, drawing, 4-column tables, footer, all on one page (print-308_win.jpg). Weaknesses: the drawing fills less than half its card while the title block is as big as or bigger than the part (detail-9_mm_luger.jpg, detail-22_long_rifle.jpg). The E1/P1/H2/G1 labels line up into one ambiguous string on short cases (9 mm Luger). The α label and marker are crowded at the shoulder (detail-9_3_x_74_r.jpg).
evidence.accessibility: Skip link, a labelled search and select, th scope=col with captions on every value table, dl for the facts, role=status on the count, focus moved to h1 on navigation (app.js:32), :focus-visible outline, and role=img with aria-label on the SVG. The drawing's text alternative is only the name; the values are available in the tables. Muted text #55606b on white passes contrast.
evidence.simplicity: No runtime dependencies and only Playwright as a dev dependency. About 1,400 lines of JS for geometry, label placement and views fits the problem. The collision-avoiding label search and the dual screen/print scale text add some complexity, but it serves the brief.
evidence.maintainability: README covers use, file layout, test commands and the Playwright and container-library setup. There are OpenSpec specs per capability, and the unit and e2e regression suites are thorough, with a lockfile. Missing: there is no CI pipeline. No Node version is pinned (no engines field or .nvmrc). There are no ADRs, and README points to openspec/changes/archive/.../design.md, which is not in the repo. Versioning is only package.json 1.0.0, with no changelog.
evidence.visual_design: Consistent restrained palette, a rust-coloured dimension layer against a dark outline, monospace numbers, and tidy table cards (detail screenshots). The print view is clean black on white. Drawbacks: the title block's 3–4 mm fonts outweigh the part. On the case walls the hatching reads as a thin grey line rather than a hatched cut (detail-308_win.jpg, detail-300_win_mag.jpg).
evidence.layout: The hierarchy is logical: heading with actions, facts, drawing, then the cartridge and chamber tables. But the drawing frame wastes large areas: the MIN_ASPECT 1.7 widening (drawing.js:68) and the right-aligned title block leave the left third empty, and the cartridge is drawn small (detail-9_mm_luger.jpg, detail-22_long_rifle.jpg). On the list page the '25 cartridges' count floats at the far right, detached from the table, which is capped at 56rem (list.jpg). No labels overlap or are clipped anywhere.
evidence.usability: Live filtering, family select, filter state kept in the URL and restored on Back (app.test.js:104-121), bookmarkable detail URLs, a not-found view with a way back, and a one-click Print. Alternative names are shown under each list name, which helps search. The list cannot be sorted, and the drawing is hard to read on a phone without zooming.
evidence.reception: Reloaders and engineers would trust the faithful values, the tolerances beside values, the source footer and the clean A4 print. The generated drawing looks credible against the OpenBallistics references. The small part with a huge title block and the crowded label rows on short cases make it look a little less polished than a professional drawing sheet.

unmet_requirements: Drawing legibility on a phone is marginal: 2.8 mm labels come out at about 7 px at phone width (test/out/phone-draw.png)
The cut walls are hatched in code, but the 1 mm hatch pitch on 0.6 mm walls hardly shows as hatching (detail-308_win.jpg)
The α label is shown, but its angle marker is a roughly 3 mm arc at the body-side corner that is barely visible
strengths: The geometry engine follows every drawing rule exactly, including belt ramp, rimfire half-round, tangent ogive, heeled bullet, blended walls and pockets, and states each missing value instead of inventing one
Excellent tests: rule-level unit checks, no label overlap for all 25 records, and a print-to-PDF check that every cartridge fits one A4 page
Faithful data presentation (tolerances beside values, D-M-S angles, symbols, units) with a clean, dense one-page A4 print
issues: The drawing is small within its frame while the title block is oversized; on short cases (9 mm Luger, 22 LR) the title block outweighs the cartridge and the left third of the frame is empty
Diameter labels pack into ambiguous rows on short cases ('E1 8.79 P1 9.93 H2 9.65 G1 9.03'), and the α marker is tiny; the case-wall hatching barely reads at screen and phone size
No CI pipeline, no pinned Node version, and README references a design document that is not in the repository
review.verdict: A careful, well-tested build: the geometry, data formatting and A4 print all follow the brief closely, and the code is clean and safe. Before publishing, the drawing needs a better balance of part to title block and clearer labels for small cartridges, and the repo needs CI and a pinned runtime.
